svg.title: A trash for deleted tickets and epics — SoftTrack web design mockup (#323)
svg.desc: Deleting a ticket or an epic removes it for good, and any member can do it to anyone’s. Deleting moves to a trash that a team can restore from for 30 days, a link to a deleted ticket says who deleted it and when, and a team setting decides who may delete.
